messages:
Ivy: Quick thread on the Midnight spectrum pass — need rapid decisions on chart palettes, syntax colors, and the theme toggle copy.
Marco: Chart palette: current purple→pink ramp looks pretty but confuses value ordering in colorblind sims. Propose a luminance-forward ramp with slight hue shift for richness.
Sasha: Agreed. For syntax, identifiers are too neon. Move ids to muted teal, keywords to warm apricot, strings to desaturated lime. Keep link color as distinct cyan.
Ivy: Copy: change "Dim Mode" to "Appearance: Light / Dark / System" and add aria-label "Toggle appearance". Also add tooltip: "T to toggle".
Marco: Heatmap cells: add 1px semi-opaque divider instead of patterns to avoid raster perf. Test on low-end devices for paint time.
Sasha: I'll update Figma with two swaps: "Luma-first + subtle chroma" and "Muted spectrum". Drop tokens and before/after screenshots in the task.
DevBot: Created issue THEME-4128 with Figma links (internal).
Ivy: Cool — scheduling a 10-min sync tomorrow to pick the winner. Thanks! :thumbsup:
